try again on 20261030-185437-1tbs
Reclaim interrupted jobs' build folders and check free disk before the producer starts, not only after it. The earlier plan's design was sound; it failed on two points, so fix them:
- Put the drain tests in a new integration test file under crates/athena-cli/tests/ that uses tests/common as the other integration tests do. Do not include tests/common/mod.rs into a library unit-test module with #[path]; it names the crate as athena_cli and will not compile there.
- The free-disk check before the producer is in scope: crates/athena-core/src/run/producer.rs and run/mod.rs may change. A test shows a job whose free disk is below the requirement is held before any producer call, and fails on today's code.
- A test shows a Dispatched job with no registry entry and a free job lock has its target/ removed at drain start, while its work tree and candidate stay.
- CHANGELOG.md gets an entry.
Priority: high
